note: Seed registry of common MCP servers and their install commands (Pastor Wave 1, Day 4; hardened Day 6). Source of truth is versioned here; runtime may override at ~/.mooter/cache/mcp_install_registry.json. Keys are lower-case canonical MCP ids matched against pack.yaml mcps.{required,recommended}. Commands verified against official docs / research_best_in_class_2026.md §2/§8/§9/§12 on 2026-05-27. Remote-only official servers use 'claude mcp add --transport http|sse <name> <url>'; stdio servers use the bare npx/uvx/pipx command.

github.install: claude mcp add --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ --header "Authorization: Bearer <github_pat>"
github.note: Official GitHub remote MCP (github/github-mcp-server). Needs a fine-grained PAT. Reference stdio server @modelcontextprotocol/server-github is deprecated.

playwright.note: Official Microsoft browser automation + accessibility tree navigation. Requires a browser binary.

filesystem.note: Official Anthropic reference server: scoped local filesystem access. Pass allowed directories.

postgres.note: Read-only Postgres query + schema inspection. Reference server archived upstream; community forks exist.

supabase.note: Official Supabase MCP: tables, migrations, edge functions. Scope with --project-ref / --read-only.

notion.note: Official Notion MCP: pages, databases, search. Remote alt: claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp.

linear.install: claude mcp add --transport sse linear https://mcp.linear.app/sse
linear.note: Official Linear remote MCP (OAuth): issues, projects, cycles.

slack.note: Slack channels, messages, search. Reference server (now community). Needs SLACK_BOT_TOKEN + SLACK_TEAM_ID.

vercel.install: claude mcp add --transport http vercel https://mcp.vercel.com
vercel.note: Official Vercel remote MCP (OAuth): deployments, projects, logs. Read-only at launch.

figma.note: Framelink Figma MCP: design context, screenshots, code connect. Official alt: Figma Dev Mode MCP at http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp (Figma desktop, Dev/Full seat).

sentry.note: Official Sentry MCP: issues, traces, releases. Remote alt: claude mcp add --transport http sentry https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp.

stripe.note: Official Stripe MCP: products, prices, payments. Remote alt: claude mcp add --transport http stripe https://mcp.stripe.com.

snyk-mcp.note: Official Snyk MCP ships inside the Snyk CLI (v1.1296.2+), Early Access (--experimental). Global alt: npm i -g snyk && snyk mcp -t stdio.

motion-canvas-mcp.install: # motion-canvas-mcp: no published MCP server verified as of 2026-05-27 — author one or animate via the Motion Canvas CLI (https://motioncanvas.io)
motion-canvas-mcp.note: UNVERIFIED. Motion Canvas is a real animation library but no canonical MCP package was confirmed in the 2026-05-27 research. Do not present as copy-paste-ready.

excel-mcp.note: Community Excel MCP (haris-musa/excel-mcp-server): read/write xlsx, formulas, named ranges, no Excel install needed.

puppeteer.note: Headless Chrome automation + screenshots. Reference server archived upstream; prefer playwright.

google-drive.note: Google Drive search + file read. Reference server archived upstream; community forks exist.

memory.note: Official Anthropic reference server: knowledge-graph persistent memory.

gitguardian.note: GitGuardian secrets detection, pre-commit + CI. Requires GITGUARDIAN_API_KEY.

sequential-thinking.note: Official Anthropic reference server: structured step-by-step reasoning.

fetch.note: Official Anthropic reference server: fetch a URL and convert to markdown.

time.note: Official Anthropic reference server: timezone conversions.

git.note: Official Anthropic reference server: read/search/manipulate a git repo.

brave-search.note: Official Brave Search MCP. Needs BRAVE_API_KEY.

obsidian.note: Community Obsidian MCP (MarkusPfundstein/mcp-obsidian). Requires the Obsidian Local REST API plugin + API key.

cloudflare.install: claude mcp add --transport sse cloudflare-docs https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/sse
cloudflare.note: Cloudflare ships several official remote MCP servers (docs, bindings, observability, ...). Docs server shown; swap host per product.
